models.summary: Unlimited-OCR is a multilingual vision-language model for optical character recognition and document parsing with long-context capabilities.
Laguna S 2.1 is a 118B-parameter MoE model with 8B activated parameters designed for agentic coding and long-context reasoning tasks.
Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion is a fine-tuned model optimized for consumer hardware with enhanced reasoning and problem-solving across general and coding tasks.
Solar Open 2 is a 250B-parameter MoE model activating 15B tokens per token, designed for agentic workflows with 1M-token context.
Nanbeige4.2-3B is a compact 3B-parameter model with looped transformer architecture for agentic, reasoning, and code-agent tasks.
Mage-Flow is a 4B-parameter text-to-image generation and editing model with efficient native-resolution diffusion and instruction-based editing capabilities.
Inkling is a 66-layer multimodal MoE model accepting text, image, and audio inputs for conversational and agentic applications.
GLM-5.2 is a language model with 1M-token context, advanced coding capabilities with variable reasoning effort, and improved sparse-attention architecture.
KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev is a 35B-parameter MoE model with 3B activated for specialized agentic coding and reasoning tasks.
Ternary Bonsai 27B is a ternary-quantized language model retaining 95% of full-precision intelligence while fitting in ~7.2GB for on-device deployment.
